exposure: Antibiotic use in the first 2 years of life
cohort: 671,606 singleton live births in Denmark from 1997 to 2010
finding: Results from the between-within model, which provided more precise and valid estimates than sibling-stratified Cox models, do not support a causal relation between antibiotic treatment during infancy, cesarean delivery, and autism.
mod_finding: Intrapartum cesarean delivery was not associated with autism risk in the between-within model (HR = 1.06, 95% CI = 0.89, 1.26).
